tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal sa skyar bek+tse lcam dral gyi gtor bzlog la cho ga'i yan lag rnams ji ltar mdzad tshul rno myur 'phrin las sgo 'byed bzhugs so// na mo gu ru dharmā pā la tsa dwe ya/ 'dir nged rang gi brtsams pa'i gnod sbyin chen po zangs kyi bek+tse can gyi gtor bzlog la cho ga'i yan lag phra mor gyur pa rnams rang rang gtor bzlog gi phyag len spyi khog nas kha skong ba bla ma gong ma mang pos phyag gsol la yod pa ltar/ dpal sa skya 'di na dus phyis sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje yab sras las 'ongs pa'i phyag len kho na dar so che bas de'i lugs ltar brjod na/ bdag bskyed kyai rdor gyi byed tshe sngon 'gro gtor ma drug cu pa bzhin kyai rdor gnas yo byin brlabs lam dus kyi mngon rtogs bzlas pa bcas dang / phur pa ltar na sngon 'gro gtor ma gong bzhin phur pa'i gnas yo dang rol mo byin brlabs/ mngon rtogs rnams rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang rung dang / mngon rtogs bsdus pa phur chung ltar na sngon 'gro gtor ma'i rjes su mchod pa byin brlabs/ ḍā dril sogs rgyun bzhin byas kyang chog gang ltar yang yi dam chos skyong spyi'i gtor bsngo/ bskang ba bstod pa rnams ni rgyas bsdus ci rigs las dmigs bsal mi dgos/ chos skyong byings la'ang drag po'i las dang rjes 'brel bskul byed par spro na bya zhing / ma byung yang chad skyon med/ dngos gzhi 'di'i gtor bzlog sgrub tshul ni gzhung du bshad pa ltar rdor glu sogs grub pa dang / mchod gtor byin brlabs nas bzung / ye shes pa spyan 'dren gyi badz+ra sa mā dzaḥbar gzhung bzhin gtor bsngo la'ang rnga rol mdzad pa ni rang lugs la yod pa ni yang phur gur drag sogs kyi gtor 'bul gyi tshig bla med mchod pa la dbyangs rol yod pa dang / zhal gyi gtor bzlog la'ang de bzhin bzhugs pa sogs 'dir spros kyi dbang du btang nas dbyangs rol byed par spro na/

bcom dung bcom rol rkang gling g.yab dar sogs thugs dam ma'i mgo bzhin kye ye zhes sbyar la sh+lau ka bskang gsar spyan 'dren gyi dbyangs rol/ de rjes sh+lau ka gcig 'dur shur gang rung gi mthar tshig rol chems brdung / phyag 'tshal sh+lau ka gnyis 'dur shur gang rung gi tshig rol chems brdung rol bskor 'bebs bcas/ rak+mo pra ṇa at+ma sa pa ri wā ra sa mā ya sa ma ra si sogs dam bzhag mtshan sngags gcig sngon 'gro'i mchod yon nas rol mo'i bar la so so'i phyag rgya 'dod yon lnga'i phyag rgya gsang 'dus bzhin/ sman raka gnyis mtheb srin gyi 'bul tshul rdor thal kha phye'i mthar se gol dang bcas gtor sngags lan bdun gyis nang gi mchod pa phrin bcol la thal sbyar gyi mthar thal brdeb gsum byas la gtor mgron gyi steng gi nam mkhar bla ma yi dam bzhugs pa'i sku las bdud rtsi babs nas chos skyong las brgyud de bdag gzhan sogs kyi sdig sgrib sbyong ba'am/ yang na chos skyong gtso 'khor gyi thugs kar zla dkyil la hūm̐ dkar po bsam nas bdud rtsi babs/ rgyun gyis bdag gzhan sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i dmigs pa gnyis gang rung dang bcas he ru ka'i yig brgya nyer gcig de bzhin du mgo gnon gyi dmigs pa'ang gur zhal gyi gzhung nas bshad pa ste kha bsgyur te bdag bskyed gang byas de'i sngags thung phreng 'khor/ de nas gzhung bzhin dmigs pa gsal btab la/ thog mar yab sngags phreng 'khor/ yum sngags phreng 'khor rnams bzlas mthar/ drag po'i lugs la bha ya na dmod pa thal brdab sogs byed pa'ang rang lugs bla ma gong ma'i phyag len la gnang bas de bzhin byas la/ rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sgrol gyi rjes su mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i phyi nang gi mchod pa gong gtor bsngo'i mjug bzhin gnod sbyin chen po zangs kyi bek+tse can lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams phyi nang gsang gsum gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la sogs gsung rgyun bzhin bshags pa'i sngon du phyag 'tshal byed pa spro na phyag 'tshal gsung rgyun phyag len bzhin la g.yung mo gtum mo sogs kyi rjes su chos nyid zhi ba'i sogs gong bzhin dang /

pu tra man 'dra gnod sbyin chen po zangs kyi bek+tse can 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams la zhu zhing gsol ba ni sogs/ chos skyong spyir mdzad du rung ba'i 'phags pas mdzad pa'i bshags pa tshigs lhug ma khyed thugs ma gdangs ring thung gang rung phyag 'tshal med pa ltar na/ khyed thugs ma gdangs med/ gnod sbyin chen po zangs kyi bek+tse can 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyi sku'i dam tshig sogs yon tan kun rdzogs la dbang gi mdog can 'khor bcas dgongs su gsol zhes sbyar/ gzhung nas bshad pa'i bskang rdzas byin rlabs bcom dung bcom rol/ rkang gling g.yab dar sogs so ring lugs bh+yoḥ'o zhes sbyar la spyan 'dren sh+lau ka gcig la zhal gyi spyan 'dren/ lha mchog ma'i dbyangs ring tshar gnyis rol mo bcas/ de rjes sh+lau ka gcig la myur mgyogs sde brgyad ma'i dbyangs rol/ de rjes sh+lau gnyis la so sor tshig rol re/ rjes ma'i mthar chems brdung / brtan bzhugs 'dur shur gang rung / tshig rol chems brdung rol bskor 'bebs bcas/ 'bul sngags gsum/ phyi nang gi mchod pa rnams gtor bsngo bzhin dang / phrin bcol bshags pa'i 'go bzhin bskul zhing / bskang ba'i dbyangs rol gnyis rgyun bzhin de nas zhwa gyon la/ hūm̐ dbang gi mdog can lcam dral 'khor bcas kun/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod gtor dam rdzas rnams/ /sogs/ bskang gsar gyi phrin bcol bzhin la/ gshin rje gshed dang gnyan lo sa chen sogs/ /bka' gter rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' bsgos ltar/ /ji ltar gsol ba'i 'dod don kun 'grub cing / /sogs/ 'dra ba'i mthar tshig rol dgu brdung gnyis/ khyed la phrin las sogs bzlog pa'i mthar tshig rol dgu brdung chems brdung / bzlog dung gsum brdeg len can bshags pa'i dbyangs rol sogs rgyun bzhin/ slar bstod pa gnod sbyin zangs kyi bek+tse can 'byor tshe der dbyangs rol 'jug tshul 'bri dgos yod cing /

yang na 'di rgyun du byed kyi bstod pa dbyangs rol sogs kyi mthar dbang gi mdog can lcam dral 'khor bcas rnams/ 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi sogs/ bla ma'i bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod kyi rjes su/ sbraṃ gcig gnyis gsum zhes dang dgu brdung bzlog pa bzhin/ kyai gnod sbyin sogs bskul la rnga phyir brdung dang / dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i la tshig rol dgu brdung / bh+yoḥrigs pa'i sogs kyi mthar tshig rol dgu brdung / chems brdung gcig gnyis gsum byas bzhag la slob dpon gyi mdun du liṅga skam thun rlon thun/ zangs gri/ phud chang / gu gul rnams bshams/ liṅga'i mgo kha'u pa'i ring lugs 'dzin pa rnams ltar na slob dpon ngos dang / rnying lugs dang sa lo gong dkar ba'i phyag len ltar na mdun bskyed ngos la ston pa gang rung las 'dir phyi ma ltar byas la dgug gzhug spyi 'gre bzhin lan gsum gyi mthar las rdor gyi liṅga'i mgo phyogs su langs nas phud chang bzung / slob dpon gyi lha dbye/ bdug rdzas gu gul sbyar ba'i spos phor bzung la/ rol mo dang bstun pa'i lag stabs bya zhing / sbraṃ sbraṃ 123zhes dang dgu brdung gcig dkon mchog sogs lha dang dbye/ tshig 'dur shur gang rung gi mthar tshig rol dgu brdung chems brdung dang bstun las rdor gyi phud chang phyir gtor slob dpon gyi liṅga dud pas bdug lcam dral sngags kyi mthar sarba de wa rak+ṣa bi re sha ma hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci rigs brjod/ de nas rdor dril thogs la/ rol mo dang bstun pa'i lag stabs dang / sbraṃ sbraṃ gcig gnyis gsum zhes dang / bdun brdung gsum che gcig dpang gzugs la 'das dang ma'i 'dur gdangs dang bcas srid pa'i nas/ kha dmar bsrung ma gnyan gyi thob bar la nga yi ma nyes nas sbrel mthar bdun brdung gsum che gcig rdor dril bzhag zangs ral thogs la bskul 'dur shur gang rung gi rjes su tshig rol dgu brdung gi mthar chems brdung dang bstun lcam dral gyi sngags brjod bzhin pas skam thun rlon thun gyis brabs/

mgo la dum bu gcig dang / lag pa g.yas g.yon gyi dpung pa gru mo mkhrig ma rkang pa'i dpyi/ spus mo bol rnams thog mar 'phral/ de nas dum bur byas te rnam shes mi bskyod pa'i zhing zhes pa mdun gyi chos skyong gi thugs dang dbyer med du bsres nas 'jog pa'i lta ba la phyag mtshan gyen du bsgreng ba sogs spor ba'i steng ka gong dkar lugs la med cing / 'dir bsgral mchod kyi skor yang zhal gyi gtor ma zhi drag gi cho ga gnam lcags 'bar ba sor bzhag la tshig bsgyur ba yin pas de bzhin bya/ drag dung gzhan rnams mthong brgyud bzhin/ bsgral mchod grub ma thag ling ro de nas las rdor gyi phud mtshon tsam zhig zor gtor ma la blugs la sman rag gi bran/ lhag ma gsol ka'i phyir gtor drung du bzhag zhwa gyon zhing / rnga phyir brdung de ga'i mu nas rol mo dgu brdung gcig bskul 'dur shur gang rung gi mthar tshig rol dgu brdung byas la bzhag lcam dral gyi sngags so so nas nyer gcig re 'ur 'don/ de nas thog mar gtor ma'i drung du snod gcig gi nang du liṅga'i dum bu dang gong du gsol bar bshams pa'i zas sna rnams bsdus g.yas khrag phor dang / g.yon du chang phor bshams la/ chos nyid zhi ba'i sogs sh+lau ka gcig la bskang gsar spyan 'dren gyi dbyangs rol/ de rjes 'dur ma'i mthar gsum brdeg gsum/ mgon po'i mtshan gsol gyi dbyangs rol sogs mgon mdos bzhin gsol kha'i bcol bskul gyi mthar drag rol dung rkang gling yang mgon mdos bzhin byas la/ las gtor gyi gtor ma'i mdun nas gsol kha'i rdzas dang khrag chang btab/ yang gtor ma'i g.yas su sngar bzhin bshams/ gong bzhin gsum brdeg byas pa/ chos nyid zhi ba'i/ bde chen lhun grub ma'i dbyangs rol gzhan thams cad gong 'dra yang gtor ma rgyab tu bshams la/ chos nyid zhi ba'i la myur mgyogs sde brgyad kyi dbyangs rol gzhan 'dra/

yang g.yon du gsham la/ chos nyid zhi ba'i la shar phyogs sgo srung ma'i dbyangs bcug nas tshigs rkang dgu bdun gyi brgyad bsgyur ba dang / gsum brdeg len med gzhan 'dra yang mdun du bshams/ hūm̐ nga' nga' zhes sbyar la/ chos nyid zhi ba'i la baiḍūr+ya sngon po'i dbyangs rol gzhan 'dra'o/ /gsol kha la bstod pa nas bcol bskul gyi bar lan lnga byed pa de'i rtsa ba'i yig rnying gi dgongs par rang lugs bla ma gong ma'i phyag len gyi rgyun yar klung pa khu dpon nas brgyud kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa la bka' babs pa de sor bzhag yin/ gtor bzlog gi dngos bstan la/ de nas tshogs 'khor sogs bya ba bshad pa bzhin byas kyang chog gtor ma 'phangs pa'i nyin gyi ngag 'don rnams goms par byas ba'i phyir bskul byas kyang mi 'gal bas na gsol kha rjes mar chems brdung gi mthar gsum brdeg len can byas la kye bos ma tshig rkang bzhi dang / tshig rkang lnga la chos nyid ma'i dbyangs rol lugs rnga nang brdung / dpal ldan gnod sbyin sogs 'dur shur gang rung / bzlog rol chos nyid ma lugs/ bzlog pa tshig rkang bdun sbrel nas chos nyid ma'i bzlog dbyangs rol mo/ srid pa'i khram kha nas 'dur shur gang rung ma mo'i khrag zor dang / nad rims bzhi brgya dang / bud med dmod zor rnams tshig rol dgu brdung / rgyal bsen bar chad sogs kyi rjes su/ de la sogs pa'i gdug sems rnams/ /thams cad sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yoḥ /zhes dang / thams cad rbod gtong la tshig rol dgu brdung / khyed la phrin las sogs gong bskang ba bzhin mthar dgu brdung / yang thams cad sdang ba'i sogs/ dus 'dir la tshig rol dgu brdung / bskul rnams kyi gral gyi bshan pa dang / 'dir yig phreng phyed mi gsal bshan pa'i dang / srog bdag brgyad kyi dang / dgra bo'i srog rtsa dang / dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i rnams la tshig rol dgu brdung re re byas la/ rjes ma'i mthar chems brdung gsum brdeg len can/

tshogs 'khor kyai rdor ltar na/ mgon mdos bzhin la zhal gyi gtor sngags kyi rjes su bek+tse'i gtor sngags/ lhag ma spyi btab/ phur pa ltar na gtor sgrub zhag du byed kyi bar la lhag ma bsags la zor 'phen nyin gsol kha'i rjes su tshogs thog mtha' bar gsum dang / lhag ma rgyas bsdus sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring dang bstun pa'i gang dgos bya/ gang ltar yang nyin dang po rnams la/ spyi btab kyi rjes su bek+tse'i sgos btab/ srid zhi dpal 'byor ma bdag bskyed gang byas dang bstun pa'i gzhug chog dang / 'phen nyin gsol kha tshogs phud phul grub nas sam/ yang na lhag ma grub nas slob dpon chas su bzhugs te ji ltar rigs par kye bos kyis bskul mthar rol mo gsum brdeg len can gyi rjes su rol mo sbraṃ sbraṃ 123byas zhes sogs gsum brdung ngam/ 'ga' re byas zhes pa de bzhin bos nas bzhi brdung zhes pa'ang snang bas de'i mu nas gtor ma phyir 'khyer la ji ltar rigs par ra gzugs 'bri mog gis byugs pa dang gser skyems bshams/ zor gtor yang re zhig bzhag la/ rol mo gsum brdeg len can dang / 'dir bsgos btab kyi mthar 'then rkang chems brdung gnyis/ dgu brdung sogs drug cu pa bzhin/ bzlog pa'i dbyangs rol tshang ma gong bzhin byas la/ gtor ma 'phen par gsum brdeg len can byas nas rnga rol bzhag gser skyems kyai rdor ltar na drug cu pa bzhin/ phur pa'i gser skyems bsdus pa ltar la dpal ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma'i rjes su/ zhing skyong dbang phyug zhal bzhi pa/ /lcam dral dregs pa'i tshogs dang bcas/ /zhes pa'i khongs su bek+tse 'dus kyang dmigs bsal byed par spro na/ skyes bu dbang gi mdog can dang / /pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma/ /las mkhan srog bdag dmar po dang / /gying brgyad shan pa nyer gcig sogs/ /bek+tse lcam dral 'khor bcas dang / /dur khrod bdag po sogs/ bla ma rig 'dzin ma ltar na/

/bstan pa srung mdzad sogs rdzogs mtshams skyes bu sogs gong gi de sbyar la/ 'khor bcas rnams/ gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la/ gdug pa'i dgra bgegs sogs/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten skyong rnams dang sogs/ gser skyems grub nas chems brdung gi rjes su dgu brdung / srid pa'i rtse mo sogs dpang gzugs 'dur shur gang rung gi mthar tshig rol dgu brdung zor lam dbye ba rgyun bzhin bskul gong bzhin la bh+yoḥgazhan yang khyod kyi sogs dang bstun/ slob dpon gyis rwa zor thogs la 'gros kyi ngang nas gtor ma dang nye bar phyin/ bde chas dang bcas bskul rdzogs pa'i dgu brdung gi mthar dzam gyi rjes su chems brdung dang bstun bek+tse lcam dral gyi sngags bzla bzhin pas rwa zor 'phangs/ gtor ma dzam len sngon 'gros 'phangs shing / bsrung 'khor sogs rgyun bzhin/ de'i sang nyin gtang rag bskang gso byed pa lta bu yin sgrub khang 'gug nas/ srid zhi dpal 'byor ma sogs kyai rdor ltar na de'i gong du tshogs la longs spyod dang / lhag gtor sgrub gtor rnams de 'phral 'bul ba lta bu yin na gtor rgyag grub 'phral sgrub khang gi rtser spyi btab gtor spod rnams song bzhin la bek+tse'i spyi btab sbyar/ phur pa yin na bstan skyong / sgrub khang du mjug chog bya ba sogs rgyun gyi phyag len gyi rigs 'gre shes so// //zhes pa 'di yang sa skya pa kun blos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gzhu lung pa'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ sa skyar bek+tse lcam dral gyi gtor bzlog ji ltar mdzad tshul/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
